run_send_greeting_messages: run the script to send multiple greeting messages to a gRPC backend server
run_process_single_request: run the process function to send a single SayHello request and print the response
run_run_with_address: run the run function to connect to a gRPC address and send N greeting messages
review_process_rpc_error_handling: review the process function to see how gRPC RpcError exceptions are caught and printed
refactor_run_channel_creation: refactor the run function to use a secure gRPC channel instead of insecure_channel
